Subject: Security review kickoff & stakeholder mapping - Medora Health

Hi Jordan & Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time on Friday — great to learn more about Medora's roadmap for embedding clinical AI into the provider portal. As promised, quick recap and next steps so we can get your security intake started.

Recap (what we heard):
- Primary integration: Redwood API for text generation + embeddings to power clinician summarization and search.
- Initial scope: production environment only (no PHI in pilot), will evaluate on staging first.
- Decision criteria: latency under 300ms 95th, per-token cost target, SOC 2 + data isolation controls.

Open items / asks from your side:
1) Stakeholder mapping: who is the economic buyer, security lead, legal/procurement contacts, and the technical owner for the integration?
2) Timeline: target pilot start date and any procurement windows we should be aware of.
3) Systems in scope: which Medora systems will call Redwood (staging/prod names), and whether there is a separate logging/retention requirement.

Next steps (from Redwood):
- I will attach our standard security questionnaire (xlsx) and a short intake checklist for systems in scope.
- Neha (cc'd) will lead the security intake and can schedule a kickoff once we have stakeholders.
- I'll follow up by EOD Tuesday to confirm stakeholders and share the questionnaire.

Attachments: Medora_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (attached)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Jordan / Priya / procurement team,

Thanks for the context — I'm Neha from Redwood's security team, I lead third-party intake for new customers. A few quick notes to get the kickoff scheduled and scope clarified:

1) Questionnaire intake: please send the completed Medora_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx to me (neha.kapoor@redwood.com) and procurement@medorahealth.com. If there are large attachments (network diagrams, architecture docs), a secure Drive link is fine.

2) Systems in scope: based on Jordan's note, we'll treat medora-stg-clinical as evaluation-only (no PHI) and medora-prod-clinical as production/HIPAA-in-scope. For production, we'll need details on: data flow diagrams, retention policies, logging endpoints, and whether logs are forwarded to a central SIEM.

3) Timeline & kickoff: propose 30-min kickoff on Thu, Dec 9 or Mon, Dec 13 to walk through questionnaire and confirm artifacts. Please indicate preferred window (morning or early afternoon PT).

4) Evidence & redlines: if legal/procurement have standard contract redlines or a vendor security questionnaire (e.g., OneTrust/Vanta export), please share alongside the completed questionnaire to speed review.

5) Point of contact matrix (so we know who to invite):
- Economic buyer: Priya Rao (decision/commercial)
- Security lead: Ravi Patel (security)
- Technical owner: Samir Khan (engineering)
- Procurement: procurement@medorahealth.com / Laura Chen

If helpful, I'm happy to jump on a separate call with procurement to answer any contract or SLA questions.

Thanks — will wait for the completed questionnaire and a preferred kickoff slot.

Best,
